project: Meridian Retail Group Customer Churn Prediction

artifact.artifact_handling: The file is a byte-for-byte copy of the saved joblib artifact. Load it with joblib.load(), even though the official filename uses the .pkl extension. It was not retrained or re-serialized.

class_mapping.0: Active: at least one completed order during the outcome period
class_mapping.1: Churned: no completed order during the outcome period

prediction_contract.api_prediction_rule: Predicted churn = 1 when predicted probability for class 1 is greater than or equal to 0.60; otherwise 0.

modelling_data_and_validation.historical_feature_rule: Historical features use completed orders dated before 2026-01-02.

evaluation.evaluation_caveat: The project notebook also examined the test set while comparing classification thresholds. Therefore, threshold-specific test metrics are exploratory and are not a completely untouched final evaluation. Evaluate on a new future holdout period before production use.

runtime_compatibility.compatibility_note: scikit-learn model persistence is version-sensitive. Use the recorded scikit-learn version when loading this artifact. The workspace used for preparing these files had scikit-learn 1.8.0 and could not deserialize this 1.6.1 artifact because a private ColumnTransformer class changed. The Phase 9 notebook records that the original saved model was reloaded successfully in its training environment and produced predictions identical to the fitted model.

important_limitations: The churn target is tied to the stated historical cutoff and six-month outcome period; it is not proof of permanent customer abandonment.
The 0.60 threshold is provisional and should be chosen according to the business costs of false positives and false negatives.
The test set was involved in threshold comparison, so a new time-based holdout evaluation is needed.
Feature importance is predictive, not causal.
The saved model expects the 16 named predictor columns and their training-time meanings.
metadata_source: API/app.py in the submitted project archive
